items.headline: The key to No. 21 Florida's electric offense? Physicality
items.description: SEC Network's Benjamin Watson breaks down how the Gators' relentless physicality has launched Florida's offensive production into another tier.

items.headline: Major Wright on Florida's new coaches: 'He has me ready to play'
items.description: Wright joins The Paul Finebaum Show and speaks highly of the Gators and believes in the new coaching staff along with highlighting his new program "On The Wright Way Foundation".

items.headline: Golden, Sumrall describe what makes culture at Florida different
items.description: Todd Golden and Jon Sumrall describe the connection between their two programs as they discuss how the Gators' culture impacts their levels of success.

items.headline: Steve Spurrier on Florida's new coaching staff: 'I really like what's happening'
items.description: Gators' Spurrier joins The Paul Finebaum Show and explains how he likes the new direction the program is going in Gainesville, ranging from the players to the offensive scheme.

items.headline: Florida's Stricklin describes what makes Sumrall so special as a coach
items.description: Scott Stricklin joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss the factors that went into Jon Sumrall's hiring process and how he knew early on that he was the right person for the job.

items.headline: Sean McDonough reveals biggest storyline behind Ole Miss vs. Florida
items.description: Following the No. 4 Rebels' dramatic win at home, ESPN's Sean McDonough details on The Paul Finebaum Show how tough it will be facing the No. 21 Gators in the Swamp.
